from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A parsed provided paper: its title and the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as found in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the collection) that this paper explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
